    line_input = sys.stdin.readline()
    n, mod = map(int, line_input.split())
    if n == 1:
        print(0)
        return

    total_result = 0
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        new_zs = [0] * (i * i // 2)
        for j in range(len(current_zs)):
            for k in range(i):
                if current_zs[j] > 0:
                    new_zs[i - k - 1 + j] += current_zs[j]
        prefix_sums = [0] * (len(current_zs) + 1)
        for w in range(len(current_zs) - 1, -1, -1):
            prefix_sums[w] = (prefix_sums[w + 1] + current_zs[w]) % mod
        e_vals = [0] * (len(prefix_sums))
        f_vals = [0] * (len(prefix_sums))
        for w in range(len(prefix_sums) - 1):
            e_vals[w + 1] = (e_vals[w] + prefix_sums[w]) % mod
            f_vals[w + 1] = (f_vals[w] - w * prefix_sums[w]) % mod
        sum_ccc = 0
        for jj in range(len(current_zs)):
            L = jj + 2
            R = min(len(current_zs) - 1, i + jj)
            ccc = 0
            if R >= L:
                ccc = ((e_vals[R + 1] - e_vals[L]) * (i + 1 + jj) + (f_vals[R + 1] - f_vals[L])) % mod
            total_result = (total_result + ccc * current_zs[jj]) % mod
        total_result += (total_result * A(n, n - i)) % mod
        current_zs = new_zs
    print(total_result % mod)
